nodes.name: WorldModel Rollout Endpoint Proposal
nodes.summary: Proposes exposing WorldModelEnhanced.predict_multi_step() as a new POST /worldmodel/rollout HTTP route, enabling agents and external tools to perform multi-step state prediction (sequence of actions to final predicted state and confidence). Also adds an optional hipcortex_rollout LM tool in the VS Code extension. Purely additive — no changes to existing endpoints.

nodes.name: WorldModel Rollout Endpoint Design
nodes.summary: Details the WmRolloutRequest struct, handle_wm_rollout handler, route binding in build_router, auth whitelist entry (unauthenticated alongside /worldmodel/predict and /worldmodel/causal), and the hipcortex_rollout LM tool registration in extension.ts. Response echoes inputs with predicted_state, distribution, confidence, and steps. Empty actions array returns a uniform error response.
